description: Stitched screenshot of three items: a Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) tweet dated 5 Feb 2018 calling Adam Schiff one of the biggest liars and leakers in Washington; Rep. Adam Schiff's (@RepAdamSchiff) reply tweet about 'Executive Time' and asking the President to address the funding crisis and Dreamers; and Q drop 70055 dated Dec 10 2017 claiming Schiff is a traitor and leaker. The drop's accusations are the drop's claims, not established fact.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Follow. Little Adam Schiff, who is desperate to run for higher office, is one of the biggest liars and leakers in Washington, right up there with Comey, Warner, Brennan and Clapper! Adam leaves closed committee hearings to illegally leak confidential information. Must be stopped!. 4:39 AM - 5 Feb 2018. Adam Schiff. @RepAdamSchiff. Follow. Mr. President, I see you've had a busy morning of 'Executive Time.' Instead of tweeting false smears, the American people would appreciate it if you turned off the TV and helped solve the funding crisis, protected Dreamers or...really anything else.. Dec 10 2017, 22:29:56 Q !ITPb.qbhqo 70055. Blunt & Direct Time.. Adam Schiff is a traitor to our country.. Leaker.. NAT SEC.. EVIL.. Tick Tock.. Hope the $7.8mm was worth it.. Enjoy the show.. Q
flags: Accusations in the tweets and Q drop (liar, leaker, traitor) are claims by their authors, not verified facts

description: Screenshot of a Q drop (tripcode !UW.yye1fxo, dated 01/27/18, No.70) rendered on a lavender background. The drop addresses @Snowden, asks 'How's Russia?', references '[Mr. Contractor]', Freedom of the Press, John Perry Barlow, the freedom.press URL, and SecureDrop, and asserts 'SecureDrop>Clowns In America. NOBODY IS SAFE.' The drop's insinuations about Snowden, Barlow, and SecureDrop are the drop's claims, not established facts.
text: Q !UW.yye1fxo 01/27/18 (Sat) 12:09:33 No.70. @Snowden.. The clock is ticking.. How's Russia?. [Mr. Contractor]. Freedom of the Press.. John Perry Barlow.. https://freedom.press. SecureDrop [Whistleblowers]?. SecureDrop>Clowns In America.. NOBODY IS SAFE.. Q
flags: Q drop content transcribed as the drop's claims; 'Clowns In America' is Q-lingo for the CIA

description: Mobile screenshot of the Electronic Frontier Foundation's Deeplinks Blog obituary headline 'John Perry Barlow, Internet Pioneer, 1947-2018' by Cindy Cohn, dated February 7 2018, announcing Barlow's death. Below the headline is a stylized sketch-style portrait of Barlow overlaid with faint text from his 'A Declaration of the Independence of Cyberspace' (phrases such as 'Governments of the Industrial World' and 'flesh and steel' are partially visible). The EFF logo, a Donate button, and Twitter/Facebook/Google+ share icons are visible.
